fields.name: ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration> shard-set collection
fields.contract: ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration> is an abstract ICollection of named ShardSet instances. Its string indexer returns the ShardSet associated with the supplied key; Count reports the number of stored shard sets. IsSynchronized always reports true, and SyncRoot returns a stable per-instance synchronization object. CopyTo copies the stored ShardSet values into a ShardSet[] supplied as Array beginning at the requested index. GetEnumerator exposes the collection's string-to-ShardSet entries.
